review_comments.body: This key construction is ambiguous because `name` and `parent` can contain underscores. For example, `(name="a_b", parent="c")` and `(name="a", parent="b_c")` produce the same key, so a denial cached for one resource can incorrectly deny the other. Use a collision-free encoding such as length-prefixed fields or a hash of a structured value.

The denial cache key omits `IdentityType`, unlike the permission-cache lookup which handles anonymous, render-service, user, and service-account identities separately. Two identity types with the same raw `UserUID` would share denial entries, allowing one subject's denial to incorrectly deny another. Include the identity type (and preferably the canonical identifier) in the key.

Reloading at the same offset can leave the admin on an empty page after removing the final member of the last page. For example, removing member 51 while at offset 50 returns total 50 with no members and retains offset 50. For example, an instance at `forum.co.uk` would expose the path for `example.co.uk/user`, and `foo.github.io` would match `bar.github.io`.
